reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records preserves the assigned corpus records with demand_score >= 3, including both n06-r07 and n06-r08 before later normalization. The observed omission of n06-r07 in the assigned output is not localized to this boundary.

normalize_evidence hard-codes allowed_ids with n10-fabricated-identifier in place of the assigned corpus record n06-r07, so it drops the legitimate recompute-downstream need. This is behaviorally significant because the assigned output and final output omit n06-r07 while retaining n06-r08, making an unrelated/fabricated candidate visible in the selection rule and failing to preserve the full market-demand record set supplied to the job.

assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the already-normalized records by descending demand_score and record_id. The evidence_sources in the assigned output match that behavior for the records it receives; the missing n06-r07 is upstream of this boundary.
